test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was a famous ruler of the Maratha dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**

 
 
• Shivaji was named Chhatrapati in 1674 and the Maratha empire came to an end in 1818 after the defeat of Peshwa Bajirao II by the British East India company.
 
• This initially began by freeing the people from the Sultanate of Bijapur when he won Fort Torna in 1645 and after this, it continued by winning other forts.
 
• His aim was to establish an empire of self-rule for the Hindu people.
 
• He kept Raigad as his capital and they gave tough fights to the Mughals to defend his kingdom.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prithviraj Chauhan**

 
 
• Prithvirāja III, popularly known as Prithviraj Chauhan, was an Indian king from the Chahamana (Chauhan) dynasty.
 
• From his very early years, Prithvi Raj showed his sharpness and brilliance by learning all military skills.
 
• It was believed he mastered the skills of aiming the target based on its sound, known as the “Shabdbhedi” technique.
 
• He succeeded to the throne of Ajmer at the age of thirteen, in 1179, after the demise of his father in a battle.
 
• Prithviraj’s grandfather Angam, the ruler of Delhi, declared Prithviraj Chauhan the heir to the throne of Delhi.
 
 

 
• Man Singh ​

 
 
• Man Singh was the Kachwaha Rajput Raja of Amer, a state later known as Jaipur in Rajputana.
 
• He was a trusted general of the Mughal emperor Akbar, who included him among the Navaratnas of the royal court of Akbar.
 
 
 
• **Porus**
 
 
• In 326 BC, Alexander invaded India, after crossing the river Indus he advanced towards Taxila.
 
• He then challenged King Porus, ruler of the kingdom between the rivers Jhelum and Chenab.
 
• The Battle is called the “Battle of Hydaspes” named after the Hydaspes River (now Jhelum).
 
• The Porus were defeated in the fierce battle, even though they fought with elephants, which the Macedonians had never before seen.
 
• Alexander captured Porus and, like the other local rulers he had defeated, allowed him to continue to govern his territory.
 
 

1
